title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files for meeting participants and Facilitator
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and Facilitator controls are supported, and searches confirmed the stated gaps about Meeting Shared Files. The licensing notes should also cite the general Teams requirement, and the checklist refers to group-level availability that the tenant-level control row does not show.

claims.where: controls[1].ui and controls[1].api; summary; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No tenant UI switch or API control specifically for Meeting Shared Files is documented on Microsoft Learn.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams '"Meeting Shared Files" admin meeting policy switch PowerShell Microsoft Graph licensing price meter' and '"Meeting Shared Files" default admin control Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy Graph'; read policy and Graph results; opened Facilitator setup. claims.claim: The licensing model is included for this new option inside Teams, with feature-specific licensing unpublished.
claims.quote: Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.
claims.fix: Keep model 'included', but add to licensing.notes and Cost and licensing: 'Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in the organisation must have a Teams license before using Teams, according to Manage Teams licenses.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/user-access. Retain the separate Facilitator prerequisites and the feature-specific licensing gap.

claims.claim: The checklist recommends restricting Facilitator for groups, but the table provides only its tenant-wide Allow or Block control.
claims.quote: After rollout: 'decide whether to restrict Facilitator for those groups.' controls[0]: 'Whether Facilitator is allowed or blocked for the organisation'; scope: 'tenant'.
claims.fix: Replace the After rollout bullet with 'Review support requests about files visible to the wrong participants and decide whether to allow or block Facilitator for the organisation.' This aligns the checklist with the existing tenant-level row without adding a control.
